name: Dr Quill

intro.text: Ah, a visitor on the grass. Only fellows may walk on the grass. I am a fellow. You are, regrettably, on the grass.
Shall we settle it like scholars? With a viva. A battle viva.

win: Hmm. A first. With distinction. Do get off the grass now.
after: The university's motto is Hinc lucem et pocula sacra: from here, light and sacred draughts. We have been arguing about what the draughts are for eight hundred years.
